description: Defines the HpackHeaderTable class for managing HPACK header compression tables, including static and dynamic tables, with methods for lookup, insertion, eviction, and size management.

classes.name: HpackHeaderTable
classes.description: Manages HPACK header tables, including static and dynamic entries, with lookup and eviction functionalities.

methods.name: GetByName
methods.description: Returns the index of the lowest-index entry matching the given header name.

methods.name: GetByNameAndValue
methods.description: Returns the index of the lowest-index entry matching the given header name and value.

methods.name: SetMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the header table, evicting entries if necessary.

methods.name: SetSettingsHeaderTableSize
methods.description: Sets the SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZE bound, adjusting max size accordingly.

methods.name: EvictionSet
methods.description: Determines which entries would be evicted if a new header is inserted.

methods.name: TryAddEntry
methods.description: Attempts to add a new header entry, evicting older entries if needed.
